organic_growth.rate_effect_note: Brokerage total organic 5.8% (base 5.5%); Risk Management 4.4%; combined 5.6%. Release: P&C rates 'firm and continue to trend higher'. INFERENCE: renewal premium (rate+exposure) ~3-5% => roughly half of organic.
organic_growth.term_used: Brokerage segment organic revenue (total commissions, fees, supplemental & contingent)

organic_growth.rate_effect_note: Base 3.1%; Risk Management -2.7% (COVID claims volumes). CEO Q4-20: 'rates are up around 8% globally' but COVID exposure declines/lower new business offset. INFERENCE: rate positive, exposure/new business negative.
Base 7.5%; Risk Management 12.2%. 'P/C rates continued to move higher across nearly all geographies'. INFERENCE: renewal premium increases ~8-10% drove majority.
Base 9.4%; Risk Management 13.3%. CEO Q4-22: 'Global primary P/C renewal premium increases were more than 9% in the quarter'.

Base 8.8%; Risk Management 15.8%. CEO: renewal premium ~8.5% in Q4-23, 'similar to the 8% to 10%' through 2022-23. INFERENCE: renewal premium change (rate+exposure) explains most organic; new business net of lost business ~flat-to-positive.
Base 7.4%; supplemental +11.0%; contingent +4.4%; Risk Management 8.1%. Jan-2025 primary renewal premium increases 'above 5%'. INFERENCE: renewal premium ~5-7% during 2024.

10-K: Brokerage organic $9,786m vs $9,215m (+6%); Risk Management +6%. Q3-25 call: property renewals -5%, casualty +6%, global renewal premium ex-property ~4%. INFERENCE: rate+exposure ~3-4pts, new business/retention the rest.

latest_interim.note: Brokerage total organic 5% Q3 and 9M (base commissions & fees 4% Q3 and 9M); Risk Management 10% Q3 and 9M; combined Q3 organic 5%, reported revenue +18%. AssuredPartners (closed 18-Aug-2025) excluded from organic for first 12 months.

geography.note: 10-K: 'approximately 67% of our revenues for the combined brokerage and risk management segments' generated domestically; remaining ~33% primarily Australia, Canada, New Zealand and UK (country split not extracted). North America therefore >67% (US + Canada). China ~0 (INFERENCE).

claim_checks.finding: Brokerage total organic 9.7% (2022) -> 8.9% (2023) -> 7.5% (2024) -> 6% (2025) -> 5% (9M-26, base 4%). Management outlook earlier in 2026 was ~5.5% for FY26 brokerage (PitchBook transcript summary); 9M at 5% implies FY ~5%, consistent with qual's revised ~5%. Base commissions (4%) weaker than total (supplemental/contingent support).

claim_checks.claim: AssuredPartners integration on track; AP organic dilution 40-50bp; synergies $160m by YE26
claim_checks.finding: Confirmed only that AP closed 18-Aug-2025, that AP revenue is excluded from organic for 12 months and that Q3-26 comp ratio benefited from AP synergies (Q3-26 release). Management (Q3-25 call) said AP organic ~5% pre-close and integration on track. The $160m/$325m synergy and 40-50bp dilution figures were not found in sources retrieved here.
10-K FY2025: ~67% domestic for Brokerage + Risk Management combined.
